methodology: Read on 2026-10-17 from the Bluetooth SIG's public repository (https://bitbucket.org/bluetooth-SIG/public), branch main at commit 408f4a0305d87ea75d9f700e3c8f85aa1d3a74fd (committed 2026-10-14), as one archive of that commit: service and characteristic UUIDs from assigned_numbers/uuids, unit names from units.yaml, service ties from the permitted-characteristics files, and each characteristic's structure from its GATT Specification Supplement file in gss/. The 97 characteristics are an allow-list chosen for fitness and health devices, the SIG's User Data list and the characteristics those structures refer to (see scripts/fetch-bluetooth-gatt.mjs). One row per structure field, a struct's fields as rows under it, and one row per characteristic with no structure in the repository. Derived columns keep their evidence: flagBit and flagValue are parsed only from a "Present if bit N of … field is set to V" line, which is published in presentIf; units are the org.bluetooth.unit ids in the field's text, with the line in unitEvidence; an offset is set only where every earlier size is a plain number, else null with the varying fields in offsetVariesWith. sigService is set only where a permitted-characteristics file names the characteristic; no other file in the repository ties characteristics to services.
generatedFrom: src/data/bluetoothGatt.ts (generated by scripts/fetch-bluetooth-gatt.mjs, then by scripts/build-datasets.mjs)

fields.characteristicUuid: The 16-bit UUID as characteristic_uuids.yaml writes it
fields.sigService: The service a permitted-characteristics file lists it under; null where no file does
fields.structurePublished: yes when the repository has a gss file for the characteristic
fields.order: Position in the structure; "3.1" is the first field of the struct at position 3; null where no structure is published
fields.parentField: For a struct's field, the structure field it belongs to
fields.type: The gss type (or a struct row's data_type), verbatim
fields.sizeUnit: octets, or bits where the struct is marked size_in_bits
fields.offset: DERIVED: the sum of the earlier sizes, only where every one is a plain number; relative to the struct for a struct's field
fields.offsetVariesWith: The earlier fields whose size is not a plain number, when offset is null
fields.presentIf: The field's "Present if …" line(s), verbatim; null where it has none
fields.flagsField: DERIVED: the flags field presentIf names, when it parses as one flag bit
fields.flagValue: DERIVED: the value (0 or 1) presentIf requires
fields.units: DERIVED: the org.bluetooth.unit ids in the field's text
fields.unitEvidence: The line each unit id was read from, verbatim
fields.gssFile: The SIG's gss file at the commit read
fields.page: This site's row for the field (or the hub row where the characteristic has no page)
